senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (पुणति)
To be pure or virtuous, to do a pious or holy act.

r. 10th cl. (पूणयति)
To accumulate, to collect or heap together.

m. (-री)
A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya.

m. (-कः)
1 The elephant of the south-east quarter.
2 A leopard.
3 A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.)
4 A fragrant kind of mango.
5 Fever affecting an elephant.
6 A variety of the sugarcane.
7 A silk worm (कोषकार?)
8 A student's waterpot.
9 White, the colour.
10 A sort of leprosy.
n. (-कं)
1 A white lotus.
2 A lotus in general.
3 A white umbrella.
4 A kind of drug.
E.
पुडि to rub or grind, or according to some, to adorn, Uṇādi aff. ईक, and the form irr.

m. (-क्षः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
n. (-क्षं)
A drug.
E.
पुण्डरीक a lotus, and अक्षि an eye, aff. षच्.

n. (-कं)
1 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
2 A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya.

n. (-र्य्यं)
A creeper, a medicinal plant, used as a remedy for diseased eyes.
E.
पुडि to dissipate, (disease,) अर्य्य aff.

n. (-ण्ड्रं)
1 A red variety of the common sugarcane, (Saccharum officinarum.)
2 The name of a Daitya or infernal being, considered as incarnate in ŚIŚUPĀLA.
3 A mark or line made on the forehead with Sandal, &c.
4 A sort of creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
5 A worm.
6 A white lotus.
7 The name of a country, the greater part of Bengal and part of Behar.
m. plu. (-ण्ड्राः)
The inhabitants of that country.
E.
पुडि to rub, aff. रक.

m. (-कः)
1 A creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
2 A sort of sugarcane: see the last.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-लिः)
An elephant.
E.
पुण्ड्र sugarcane, and केलि pastime.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
1 Virtuous, pure, righteous.
2 Beautiful, pleasing.
3 Fragrant.
n. (-ण्यं)
1 Virtue, moral or religious merit.
2 A good action.
3 Purity, purification.
4 A trough for watering cattle.
f. (-ण्या)
Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
E.
पूञ् to be or make pure, यत् Uṇādi aff., and ण्वुक् augment.

n. (-कं)
A meritorious act or obligation of a religious nature, as fasting, praying, &c.
E.
पुण्य virtue, कन् added.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Pious, virtuous.
E.
पुण्य, and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-तं)
The worship of KṚṢṆA for a year, with daily presents, to be performed by a woman desirous of a son.
E.
पुण्यक, and व्रत religious obligation.

mf. (-कृत्)
Virtuous, pious.
E.
पुण्य virtue, and कृत् who acts.

m. (-न्धः)
The Champak, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
पुण्य pure, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-नः)
1 A fiend, a goblin, a Rākṣasa.
2 A Yakṣa, a divine being attendant on KUVERA, the god of wealth.
3 A pious or virtuous man.
E.
पुण्य virtuous, and जन man.

m. (-रः)
KUVERA, the Hindu deity of wealth.
E.
पुण्यजन a Yakṣa, and ईश्वर master.

n. (-र्थं)
A holy shrine or place of pilgrimage.
E.
पुण्य, and तीर्थ sacred pool, &c.

n. (-णं)
White Kusa grass.
E.
पुण्य, and तृण grass: it is much used in religious ceremonies.

m. (-नः)
The blue jay.
E.
पुण्य lucky, and दर्शन appearance.

m. (-लः)
A grove, a garden.
n. (-लं)
The reward or consequence of good actions.
E.
पुण्य handsome or virtue, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Virtuous, addicted to virtue.
E.
पुण्य, and भाज् who possesses.

f. (-भूः)
The holy land of the Hindūs; the central part of Asia, bounded on the north by the Himāla, on the south by the Vindhya mountains, and on the east and west by the sea.
E.
पुण्य virtue, and भू land.

f. (-मिः)
1 The holy land: see the last.
2 The mother of a male child.
E.
पुण्य virtue, and भूमि land.

m. (-त्रः)
A night on which any religious commemoration or ceremony is held.
E.
पुण्य, and रात्रि night, अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
Heaven, paradise.
E.
पुण्य virtue, and लोक a world.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Fortunate, well-fated.
2 Virtuous, pious, righteous.
E.
पुण्य virtue, &c. aff. मतुप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Merited, acquired by merit.
E.
पुण्य, and विजित conquered.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Virtuous.
E.
पुण्य, and शील having.

m. (-कः)
1 A name of NALA.
2 The epithet is also applied to YUDHIṢṬHIRA, and to VIṢṆU.
f. (-का)
1 A name of DRAUPADĪ.
2 Of SĪTĀ.
E.
पुण्य holy, श्वोक verse: who is celebrated in sacred poems.

m. (-गः)
The influence or effect of virtuous actions.
E.
पुण्य, and योग union.

n. (-नं)
A sacred place, holy ground.
E.
पुण्य virtue, and स्थान a place.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Holy, pious.
E.
पुण्य, and आत्मन् spirit.

n. (-हं)
A holy day.
E.
पुण्य holy, and अहन् a day.

n. (-नं)
Repeating at sacrifices, &c. ‘This is a holy day,’ three times.
E.
पुण्याह, and वाचन saying.

m. (-यः)
Good fortune, as the result of virtuous acts in a former life.
E.
पुण्य, and उदय rise.
